instructions: Instant code search for any local or remote git repository. Call `search` once with a focused query, it returns the file path and exact line. Navigate directly to that file at the given line; do not grep for the same content. Use `find_related` to discover similar code elsewhere in the same repo. When working in a local project, pass the project root as `repo`. For remote repos, pass an explicit https:// URL. Never guess or infer URLs.
